source_title: Care of adults with neurofibromatosis type 1: a clinical practice resource of the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG)
claim_text: Hypertension is common in NF1 and its incidence increases with age; the most common causes are essential hypertension, pheochromocytoma and, in young adults, renal artery stenosis.
notes: Full text from locally supplied PDF (Genet Med 2018;20:671-682; not in PMC). Statement made by the ACMG adult NF1 practice resource citing ref 52 Friedman 2002 PMID 12180143. Secondary citation: not independent of the cited primary work; primary paper should be read for strength grading.Source is the NF1 Cardiovascular Task Force report (expert consensus).
